title: USITC HTS Tariff & Landed Cost Calculator Input

query.title: HTS Code or Product Keyword
query.description: 10-digit, 8-digit, or 6-digit US HTS code (e.g. '8507.60', '8507.60.00.10', '9403.20') OR product description keyword (e.g. 'lithium-ion batteries', 'solar panels').

countryOfOrigin.title: Country of Origin (2-Letter ISO)
countryOfOrigin.description: Two-letter ISO origin country code for landed cost calculation (e.g. 'CN', 'VN', 'MX', 'CA', 'KR', 'IN', 'TW', 'DE').

compareCountries.title: Sourcing Countries to Compare
compareCountries.description: Origin country codes to compare side-by-side in multi-country landed cost analysis (e.g. China vs. Vietnam vs. Mexico vs. South Korea).

shipmentValueUsd.title: Declared Shipment Customs Value (USD)
shipmentValueUsd.description: Commercial invoice customs value (FOB value) of the shipment in USD.

freightAndInsuranceUsd.title: International Freight & Insurance (USD)
freightAndInsuranceUsd.description: Estimated international shipping and marine/air cargo insurance cost in USD.

transportMode.title: Transport Mode
transportMode.description: Mode of arrival into the US. Harbor Maintenance Fee (HMF 0.125%) applies only to ocean shipments.

additionalTariffPercent.title: Override Additional Chapter 99 Tariff (%)
additionalTariffPercent.description: Optional override for Section 301 / Section 232 / reciprocal additional duty percentage on the primary countryOfOrigin. Leave blank to auto-estimate by country and HTS chapter.

includeChapter99Notes.title: Include Related Chapter 99 USITC Provisions
includeChapter99Notes.description: Attach related Chapter 99 temporary tariff rules and suspensions returned in the USITC search tree.

maxResults.title: Maximum HTS Records
maxResults.description: Maximum number of HTS tariff lines to calculate and return (1–100).

outputMode.title: Output Mode
outputMode.description: Choose between detailed tariff dataset records or a compact MCP landed-cost summary.
